propositions: When multiple sessions write the shared store concurrently, plan-review signing computes PASS but aborts with store-read-failure (retryable: false), preventing non-force close.
The generation loop treats transient store-read-failure from pre-lock reads (tracker_head_sha/collect) as terminal, while the sibling moving-HEAD transient is retried within MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS.

A peer session's in-flight git add→commit stages a tracked entry, causing git status --untracked-files=no to report non-empty status and trigger store-read-failure in tracker_head_sha even when ignore_untracked=True.
The fix retries store-read-failure within the existing generation loop (continue) and raises PlanReviewGenerationRetryable only after exhaustion, while deterministic snapshot errors remain terminal.
Under-lock re-check (under_lock_check) acts as a fence ensuring the authoritative read happens while holding the store write lock, making pre-lock read retries safe.
Transient store-read-failure during signing is resolved after retry and permits signing to complete; persistent failures exhaust retry budget and surface as retryable not terminal abort.
